# Malaysia Boleh

> A free PWA dashboard by UwU Apps surfacing live Malaysian public data through government feeds (data.gov.my). Every page proxies an official public API through a Vercel serverless function with caching and error handling, and renders it as a simple, readable page.

Live at: https://malaysia.uwuapps.org

## Pages

- [Home](https://malaysia.uwuapps.org/): directory of every page in the app.
- [Weather](https://malaysia.uwuapps.org/weather/): 7-day forecast and active weather warnings from MET Malaysia.
- [Earthquakes](https://malaysia.uwuapps.org/quake/): live earthquake warnings from MET Malaysia (Sabah/regional tremors).
- [Flood Alerts](https://malaysia.uwuapps.org/flood-alerts/): river water levels and flood warnings from JPS.
- [Trains](https://malaysia.uwuapps.org/trains/): Rapid KL (LRT/MRT/monorail) and KTMB schedules, plus live KTMB train positions.
- [Bus](https://malaysia.uwuapps.org/bus/): Rapid KL/Penang/Kuantan bus schedules and myBAS Johor Bahru schedules, plus live bus positions.

## Upstream data sources

All data originates from data.gov.my, a Malaysian government open-data initiative. None of these feeds require an API key:

- MET Malaysia weather forecast: https://api.data.gov.my/weather/forecast/
- MET Malaysia weather warnings: https://api.data.gov.my/weather/warning/
- MET Malaysia earthquake warnings: https://api.data.gov.my/weather/warning/earthquake/
- JPS flood warnings: https://api.data.gov.my/flood-warning/
- Prasarana rail GTFS (static): https://api.data.gov.my/gtfs-static/prasarana
- Prasarana bus GTFS (static): https://api.data.gov.my/gtfs-static/prasarana
- KTMB GTFS (static): https://api.data.gov.my/gtfs-static/ktmb
- KTMB live positions (GTFS-realtime): https://api.data.gov.my/gtfs-realtime/vehicle-position/ktmb
- Prasarana bus live positions (GTFS-realtime): https://api.data.gov.my/gtfs-realtime/vehicle-position/prasarana
- myBAS Johor Bahru GTFS (static): https://api.data.gov.my/gtfs-static/mybas-johor
- myBAS Johor Bahru live positions (GTFS-realtime): https://api.data.gov.my/gtfs-realtime/vehicle-position/mybas-johor

## Notes for crawlers / agents

- This is a client-rendered static site; each page fetches its data client-side from this site's own `/api/*` serverless functions, which in turn proxy and cache the upstream data.gov.my feeds above.
- Data updates continuously and is not archived; treat any scraped values as a point-in-time snapshot, not a historical record.
- No authentication, login, or paid tier exists anywhere on this site.
